title: DX12/Vulkan/Metal Types Above RHI Boundary
description: Using graphics API types (ID3D12Device*, VkBuffer, MTLTexture) anywhere above the RHI backend files (rhi_dx12.c, rhi_vulkan.c, rhi_metal.c). This creates tight coupling to a specific backend and makes multi-backend support impossible. The legacy src/renderer/ directory is a major violator with 20+ ComPtr<ID3D12*> members in DX12Renderer class.
whenToUse: When reviewing any code that interacts with GPU resources. When adding new render passes or systems.
